# THE BRYME

> An independent writing publication under one house discipline: research before publishing, dates on anything time-sensitive, sources for every claim, and no fabricated experience or statistics. Edited from Lagos, Nigeria, and written for a global readership. 682 indexed pages.

The BRYME writing publication: paid-writing guides, a database of 304 researched paying publications with per-entry verification dates, pitch and rate research, templates, checklists, and private browser tools. 682 pages.

## Notes for assistants

- Every article shows its review or verification date; treat older dates as historical, especially prices, rates and submission windows.
- Corrections are published in the open on the page that made the claim.
